concepts.formal: theorem Projectivization.card' (k : Type u_1) (V : Type u_2) [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [Finite V] :Nat.card V = Nat.card (Projectivization k V) * (Nat.card k - 1) + 1

concepts.definition: Nat.card (Projectivization k V) = Nat.card k + 1。
concepts.formal: theorem Projectivization.card_of_finrank_two (k : Type u_1) (V : Type u_2) [Field k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [Finite k] (h : Module.finrank k V = 2) :Nat.card (Projectivization k V) = Nat.card k + 1

concepts.cn: 射影共线的子空间刻画
concepts.definition: 射影空间中的点集共线，当且仅当它被包含在一个维数不超过 2 的有限维子空间里。
concepts.formal: theorem Projectivization.IsCollinear_iff {K : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (S : Set (Projectivization K V)) :IsCollinear S ↔ ∃ (M : Subspace K V), Module.Finite K ↥(Subspace.submodule M) ∧ Module.finrank K ↥(Subspace.submodule M) ≤ 2 ∧ S ⊆ ↑M

concepts.definition: 三维射影空间里，点 v 与叉积 v×w 的方向正交（v≠w 时）。
concepts.formal: theorem Projectivization.orthogonal_cross_left {F : Type u_1} [Field F] [DecidableEq F] {v w : Projectivization F (Fin 3 → F)} (h : v ≠ w) :v.orthogonal (v.cross w)

concepts.definition: 射影空间中两点线性无关，当且仅当它们不相等。
concepts.formal: theorem Projectivization.independent_pair_iff_ne {K : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (u v : Projectivization K V) :Independent ![u, v] ↔ u ≠ v

concepts.definition: 域中元素个数至少为 4 时，二阶射影特殊线性群 PSL(2,F) 是单群。
concepts.formal: theorem Matrix.ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup.rank_two_simple {F : Type u_2} [Field F] (hF : 4 ≤ Nat.card F) :IsSimpleGroup (ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) F)

concepts.definition: 固定一条直线的特殊线性群元素两两可交换。
concepts.formal: theorem Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.lineStab_isMulCommutative_of_span' {F : Type u_1} [Field F] {ι : Type u_2} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (v : ι → F) (hv : v ≠ 0) (A B : SpecialLinearGroup ι F) (hA : A ∈ lineStab (F ∙ v)) (hB : B ∈ lineStab (F ∙ v)) :A * B = B * A

concepts.cn: 射影子空间对加法的封闭性
concepts.definition: 若 v、w 的射影点都在射影子空间里，则 v+w 的射影点也在其中。
concepts.formal: theorem Projectivization.Subspace.mem_add' {K : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (self : Subspace K V) (v w : V) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) (hvw : v + w ≠ 0) :Projectivization.mk K v hv ∈ self.carrier → Projectivization.mk K w hw ∈ self.carrier → Projectivization.mk K (v + w) hvw ∈ self.carrier

concepts.definition: 空集生成的射影子空间是零子空间。
concepts.formal: theorem Projectivization.Subspace.span_empty {K : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] :span ∅ = ⊥

concepts.definition: 全集生成的射影子空间是全空间。
concepts.formal: theorem Projectivization.Subspace.span_univ {K : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] :span Set.univ = ⊤

concepts.definition: 非零向量 v 的射影点落在子空间 s 的射影化中，当且仅当 v 本身属于 s。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.mk_mem_projectivization_iff {K : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (s : Submodule K V) {v : V} (hv : v ≠ 0) :Projectivization.mk K v hv ∈ projectivization s ↔ v ∈ s

concepts.cn: 代数闭域上二次型的标准形
concepts.definition: 代数闭域上，有限维空间的非退化二次型等价于标准平方和 x₁²+…+xₙ²。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticForm.equivalent_weightedSumSquares_of_isAlgClosed {K : Type u_2} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] [Invertible 2] {M : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [FiniteDimensional K M] (Q : QuadraticForm K M) (hQ : LinearMap.SeparatingLeft (QuadraticMap.associated Q)) :QuadraticMap.Equivalent Q (QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares K 1)

concepts.cn: 恒等映射的二次型变换
concepts.definition: 恒等线性等价诱导的二次型变换就是恒等变换。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearEquiv.congrQuadraticMap_refl {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] :(refl R N).congrQuadraticMap = refl R (QuadraticMap R M N)

concepts.definition: 双线性映射对应的二次型的极化双线性型等于 B 与其转置之和。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.BilinMap.polarBilin_toQuadraticMap {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R M] [Module R N] {B : LinearMap.BilinMap R M N} :B.toQuadraticMap.polarBilin = B + flip B

concepts.definition: 二次型数乘 a 倍，其矩阵也数乘 a 倍。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticForm.QuadraticMap.toMatrix'_smul {R : Type u_3} {n : Type w} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (a : R) (Q : QuadraticForm R (n → R)) :(a • Q).toMatrix' = a • Q.toMatrix'

concepts.definition: 二次型数乘 a 倍，判别式变为原来的 aⁿ 倍（n 为维数）。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticForm.discr_smul {R : Type u_3} {N : Type u_5} {n : Type w} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {b : Module.Basis n R N} {Q : QuadraticForm R N} (a : R) :discr b (a • Q) = a ^ Fintype.card n * discr b Q

concepts.definition: 二次型的相伴双线性映射再转回二次型，得到自身。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticMap.associated_left_inverse (S : Type u_1) {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [CommSemiring S] [Algebra S R] [Module S N] [IsScalarTower S R N] [Invertible 2] {B₁ : LinearMap.BilinMap R M N} (h : ∀ (x y : M), (B₁ x) y = (B₁ y) x) :(associatedHom S) B₁.toQuadraticMap = B₁

concepts.definition: 两个二次映射相等，当且仅当它们在每一点取值都相等。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticMap.ext_iff {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] {Q Q' : QuadraticMap R M N} :Q = Q' ↔ ∀ (x : M), Q x = Q' x

concepts.cn: 二次映射的二次齐次性
concepts.definition: 二次映射满足 Q(a•x) = a²•Q(x)，即二次齐次性。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticMap.map_smul {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) (a : R) (x : M) :Q (a • x) = (a * a) • Q x

concepts.definition: 极化形式对左变元是线性的：polar(a•x, y) = a•polar(x, y)。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticMap.polar_smul_left_of_tower {S : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R M] [Module R N] (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) [CommSemiring S] [Algebra S R] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower S R M] [Module S N] [IsScalarTower S R N] (a : S) (x y : M) :polar (⇑Q) (a • x) y = a • polar (⇑Q) x y

concepts.definition: 二次映射作为函数满足 f(a•x) = a²•f(x)。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticMap.toFun_smul {R : Type u} {M : Type v} {N : Type w} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] (self : QuadraticMap R M N) (a : R) (x : M) :self.toFun (a • x) = (a * a) • self.toFun x

concepts.cn: 二次映射和的双线性型
concepts.definition: 两个二次映射之和对应的双线性型等于各自双线性型之和。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticMap.add_toBilin {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [LinearOrder ι] [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R M] [Module R N] (bm : Module.Basis ι R M) (Q₁ Q₂ : QuadraticMap R M N) :(Q₁ + Q₂).toBilin bm = Q₁.toBilin bm + Q₂.toBilin bm

concepts.cn: 正定二次型下的线性无关
concepts.definition: 正定二次型下，满足两两配对值非正的一族对偶向量线性无关。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.BilinForm.linearIndependent_of_pairwise_le_zero {ι : Type u_4} {R : Type u_5} {M : Type u_6} [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (B : LinearMap.BilinForm R M) (hB : (BilinMap.toQuadraticMap B).PosDef) (f : Module.Dual R M) (v : ι → M) (hp : ∀ (i : ι), 0 < f (v i)) (hn : Pairwise fun (i j : ι) => (B (v i)) (v j) ≤ 0) :LinearIndependent R v

concepts.definition: 对偶配对是左分离的，当且仅当典范赋值映射是单射。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.separatingLeft_dualProd (R : Type u_1) (M : Type u_2) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :SeparatingLeft (dualProd R M) ↔ Function.Injective ⇑(Module.Dual.eval R M)

concepts.cn: 等距映射与恒等的复合
concepts.definition: 二次型等距映射与恒等映射复合仍是自身。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticMap.Isometry.id_comp {R : Type u_1} {M₁ : Type u_3} {M₂ : Type u_4} {N : Type u_7} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂] [Module R N] {Q₁ : QuadraticMap R M₁ N} {Q₂ : QuadraticMap R M₂ N} (f : Q₁ →qᵢ Q₂) :(id Q₂).comp f = f

concepts.cn: 二次型的加权平方和标准形
concepts.definition: 有限维空间上的二次型都等价于某个加权平方和 w₁x₁²+…+wₙxₙ²（配方法的抽象形式）。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticForm.equivalent_weightedSumSquares {K : Type u_3} {V : Type u_8} [Field K] [Invertible 2] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] (Q : QuadraticForm K V) :∃ (w : Fin (Module.finrank K V) → K), QuadraticMap.Equivalent Q (QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares K w)

concepts.cn: 等距等价之逆的线性映射
concepts.definition: 等距等价的逆的底层线性映射就是其逆线性等价。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticMap.IsometryEquiv.coe_symm_toLinearEquiv {R : Type u_2} {M₁ : Type u_5} {M₂ : Type u_6} {N : Type u_9} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂] [Module R N] {Q₁ : QuadraticMap R M₁ N} {Q₂ : QuadraticMap R M₂ N} (f : Q₁.IsometryEquiv Q₂) :f.symm = f.symm.toLinearEquiv

concepts.definition: f.symm x = y 当且仅当 x = f y。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticMap.IsometryEquiv.symm_apply_eq {R : Type u_2} {M₁ : Type u_5} {M₂ : Type u_6} {N : Type u_9} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂] [Module R N] {Q₁ : QuadraticMap R M₁ N} {Q₂ : QuadraticMap R M₂ N} (f : Q₁.IsometryEquiv Q₂) {x : M₂} {y : M₁} :f.symm x = y ↔ x = f y

concepts.definition: 两对分别等价的二次型，它们的直积仍等价。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticMap.Equivalent.prod {R : Type u_2} {M₁ : Type u_3} {M₂ : Type u_4} {N₁ : Type u_5} {N₂ : Type u_6} {P : Type u_7} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [AddCommMonoid N₁] [AddCommMonoid N₂] [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂] [Module R N₁] [Module R N₂] [Module R P] {Q₁ : QuadraticMap R M₁ P} {Q₂ : QuadraticMap R M₂ P} {Q₁' : QuadraticMap R N₁ P} {Q₂' : QuadraticMap R N₂ P} (e₁ : Q₁.Equivalent Q₁') (e₂ : Q₂.Equivalent Q₂') :(Q₁.prod Q₂).Equivalent (Q₁'.prod Q₂')

concepts.definition: 两个正定二次型的直积仍正定。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticMap.PosDef.prod {R : Type u_2} {M₁ : Type u_3} {M₂ : Type u_4} {P : Type u_7} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂] [Module R P] [PartialOrder P] [AddLeftMono P] {Q₁ : QuadraticMap R M₁ P} {Q₂ : QuadraticMap R M₂ P} (h₁ : Q₁.PosDef) (h₂ : Q₂.PosDef) :(Q₁.prod Q₂).PosDef

concepts.cn: 乘积二次型的单点取值
concepts.definition: 乘积二次型在第 i 个分量单点上的取值，就是第 i 个二次型在该分量的取值。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticMap.pi_apply_single {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {P : Type u_7} {Mᵢ : ι → Type u_8} [CommSemiring R] [(i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (Mᵢ i)] [AddCommMonoid P] [(i : ι) → Module R (Mᵢ i)] [Module R P] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (Q : (i : ι) → QuadraticMap R (Mᵢ i) P) (i : ι) (m : Mᵢ i) :(pi Q) (Pi.single i m) = (Q i) m

concepts.cn: 二次模范畴的遗忘函子
concepts.definition: 遗忘函子把二次模范畴的对象送到其底层的模。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticModuleCat.forget₂_obj {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (X : QuadraticModuleCat R) :(CategoryTheory.forget₂ (QuadraticModuleCat R) (ModuleCat R)).obj X = ↧↑X.toModuleCat

concepts.cn: 二次模范畴的左单位子
concepts.definition: 二次模范畴中左单位子的同态对应张量左恒等映射的等距。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticModuleCat.toIsometry_hom_leftUnitor {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] {M : QuadraticModuleCat R} :Hom.toIsometry (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.leftUnitor M).hom = M.form.tensorLId.toIsometry

concepts.definition: 等距等价把二次型的根基（radical）送到对应二次型的根基。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticMap.IsometryEquiv.map_radical {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {M' : Type u_3} {P : Type u_4} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup M'] [AddCommGroup P] [CommRing R] [Module R M] [Module R M'] [Module R P] {Q : QuadraticMap R M P} {Q' : QuadraticMap R M' P} (e : Q.IsometryEquiv Q') :Submodule.map (↑e.toLinearEquiv) Q.radical = Q'.radical

concepts.definition: 实二次型等价于系数仅为 1、0、−1 的加权平方和，即惯性定律。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticForm.equivalent_one_zero_neg_one_weighted_sum_squared {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M] [FiniteDimensional ℝ M] (Q : QuadraticForm ℝ M) :∃ (w : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ M) → ℝ), (∀ (i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ M)), w i = -1 ∨ w i = 0 ∨ w i = 1) ∧ QuadraticMap.Equivalent Q (QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares ℝ w)

concepts.definition: 正惯性指数＋负惯性指数＋根基维数＝空间维数。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticForm.sigPos_add_sigNeg_add_radical {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] {𝕜 : Type u_4} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [Module 𝕜 M] {Q : QuadraticForm 𝕜 M} [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 M] :sigPos Q + sigNeg Q + Module.finrank 𝕜 ↥(QuadraticMap.radical Q) = Module.finrank 𝕜 M

concepts.definition: −Q 的正惯性指数等于 Q 的负惯性指数。
concepts.formal: theorem sigPos_neg {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [Module R M] {Q : QuadraticForm R M} :sigPos (-Q) = sigNeg Q

concepts.cn: 基变换后二次型的判定
concepts.definition: 基变换后的两个二次映射相等，当且仅当它们在 1⊗m 形元素上取值全同。
concepts.formal: theorem baseChange_ext_iff {R : Type uR} {A : Type uA} {M₂ : Type uM₂} {N₁ : Type uN₁} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M₂] [AddCommGroup N₁] [Algebra R A] [Module R N₁] [Module A N₁] [IsScalarTower R A N₁] [Module R M₂] {Q₁ Q₂ : QuadraticMap A (TensorProduct R A M₂) N₁} :Q₁ = Q₂ ↔ ∀ (m : M₂), Q₁ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] m) = Q₂ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] m)

concepts.cn: 张量结合子的线性等价
concepts.definition: 二次型张量结合子的底层线性等价就是张量积的结合律同构。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticForm.tensorAssoc_toLinearEquiv {R : Type uR} {M₁ : Type uM₁} {M₂ : Type uM₂} {M₃ : Type uM₃} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂] [AddCommGroup M₃] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂] [Module R M₃] [Invertible 2] (Q₁ : QuadraticForm R M₁) (Q₂ : QuadraticForm R M₂) (Q₃ : QuadraticForm R M₃) :(Q₁.tensorAssoc Q₂ Q₃).toLinearEquiv = TensorProduct.assoc R M₁ M₂ M₃

concepts.cn: 张量结合律的计算公式
concepts.definition: 二次型张量积的结合律在具体元素上的计算公式。
concepts.formal: theorem QuadraticForm.tmul_tensorAssoc_apply {R : Type uR} {M₁ : Type uM₁} {M₂ : Type uM₂} {M₃ : Type uM₃} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂] [AddCommGroup M₃] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂] [Module R M₃] [Invertible 2] (Q₁ : QuadraticForm R M₁) (Q₂ : QuadraticForm R M₂) (Q₃ : QuadraticForm R M₃) (x : TensorProduct R (TensorProduct R M₁ M₂) M₃) :(Q₁.tmul (Q₂.tmul Q₃)) ((TensorProduct.assoc R M₁ M₂ M₃) x) = ((Q₁.tmul Q₂).tmul Q₃) x

concepts.definition: 限制标量等价的逆作用在商元 mk x 上仍得 mk x。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv_symm_mk {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (S : Type u_3) [Ring S] [SMul S R] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower S R M] (P : Submodule R M) (x : M) :(restrictScalarsEquiv S P).symm (mk x) = mk x

concepts.definition: 商映射的诱导映射复合等于直接诱导的映射。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.factor_comp {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {p p' p'' : Submodule R M} (H1 : p ≤ p') (H2 : p' ≤ p'') :factor H2 ∘ₗ factor H1 = factor ⋯

concepts.definition: 诱导映射与商投影复合等于大商空间的投影。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.factor_comp_mk {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {p p' : Submodule R M} (H : p ≤ p') :factor H ∘ₗ p.mkQ = p'.mkQ

concepts.definition: 子模 p 小于沿商投影拉回的任一商子模。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.le_comap_mkQ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (p : Submodule R M) (p' : Submodule R (M ⧸ p)) :p ≤ comap p.mkQ p'

concepts.definition: 商映射的提升与投影可交换，两种复合次序结果一致。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.mapQ_mkQ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (p : Submodule R M) {R₂ : Type u_3} {M₂ : Type u_4} [Ring R₂] [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module R₂ M₂] {τ₁₂ : R →+* R₂} (q : Submodule R₂ M₂) (f : M →ₛₗ[τ₁₂] M₂) {h : p ≤ comap f q} :p.mapQ q f h ∘ₛₗ p.mkQ = q.mkQ ∘ₛₗ f

concepts.definition: 商投影把子模 p 自身送到零子模。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.mkQ_map_self {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (p : Submodule R M) :map p.mkQ p = ⊥

concepts.definition: 零子模的商等价的逆把 x 送到商元 mk x。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot_symm_apply {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (p : Submodule R M) (hp : p = ⊥) (x : M) :(p.quotEquivOfEqBot hp).symm x = Quotient.mk x

concepts.definition: 商模 M⧸p 只有一个元素，当且仅当 p 是全空间。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.unique_quotient_iff_eq_top {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {p : Submodule R M} :Nonempty (Unique (M ⧸ p)) ↔ p = ⊤

concepts.definition: 双线性映射的商提升在商元上的取值，就是原映射在代表元上的取值。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.liftQ₂_mk {R : Type u_1} {R₂ : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} {S₂ : Type u_4} {M : Type u_5} {N : Type u_6} {P : Type u_7} [Ring R] [Ring R₂] [Ring S] [Ring S₂] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [AddCommGroup P] [Module R M] [Module S N] [Module R₂ P] [Module S₂ P] [SMulCommClass R₂ S₂ P] {ρ : R →+* R₂} {σ : S →+* S₂} {M' : Submodule R M} {N' : Submodule S N} {f : M →ₛₗ[ρ] N →ₛₗ[σ] P} (hM' : M' ≤ f.ker) (hN' : N' ≤ f.flip.ker) (m : M) (n : N) :((liftQ₂ M' N' f hM' hN') (Submodule.Quotient.mk m)) (Submodule.Quotient.mk n) = (f m) n

concepts.definition: 有限模的基数＝子模基数 × 商模基数（拉格朗日定理的模版本）。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (S : Submodule R M) :Nat.card M = Nat.card ↥S * Nat.card (M ⧸ S)

concepts.definition: 相等子模的商等价把商元 mk x 送到 mk x。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.quotEquivOfEq_mk {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (p p' : Submodule R M) (h : p = p') (x : M) :(p.quotEquivOfEq p' h) (Quotient.mk x) = Quotient.mk x

concepts.definition: 商模上的两个线性映射若在所有商元上取值相同，则它们相等。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.quot_hom_ext {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (p : Submodule R M) {M₂ : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module R M₂] (f g : M ⧸ p →ₗ[R] M₂) (h : ∀ (x : M), f (Quotient.mk x) = g (Quotient.mk x)) :f = g

concepts.definition: 乘积商模的提升映射在商元上的取值为各分量映射逐点作用。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.quotientPiLift_mk {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] {Ms : ι → Type u_3} [(i : ι) → AddCommGroup (Ms i)] [(i : ι) → Module R (Ms i)] {Ns : ι → Type u_5} [(i : ι) → AddCommGroup (Ns i)] [(i : ι) → Module R (Ns i)] (p : (i : ι) → Submodule R (Ms i)) (f : (i : ι) → Ms i →ₗ[R] Ns i) (hf : ∀ (i : ι), p i ≤ (f i).ker) (x : (i : ι) → Ms i) :(quotientPiLift p f hf) (Quotient.mk x) = fun (i : ι) => (f i) (x i)

concepts.definition: 射线向量取负后等价，当且仅当原来等价。
concepts.formal: theorem RayVector.equiv_neg_iff {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [PartialOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {v₁ v₂ : RayVector R M} :-v₁ ≈ -v₂ ↔ v₁ ≈ v₂

concepts.definition: 同射线的两个非零向量之间必有正数倍关系：存在 r>0 使 r•x = y。
concepts.formal: theorem SameRay.exists_pos_left {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {x y : M} (h : SameRay R x y) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :∃ (r : R), 0 < r ∧ r • x = y

concepts.definition: x 与 y 同射线，则 −x 与 −y 也同射线。
concepts.formal: theorem SameRay.neg {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [PartialOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {x y : M} :SameRay R x y → SameRay R (-x) (-y)

concepts.cn: 反射在不变集上的双射
concepts.definition: 反射把集合 Φ 映到自身时，它在 Φ 上的限制是双射。
concepts.formal: theorem Module.bijOn_reflection_of_mapsTo {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {x : M} {f : Dual R M} {Φ : Set M} (h : f x = 2) (h' : Set.MapsTo (⇑(reflection h)) Φ Φ) :Set.BijOn (⇑(reflection h)) Φ Φ

concepts.cn: 反射乘积幂的切比雪夫公式
concepts.definition: 两个反射乘积的整数次幂作用在 x 上的显式公式，可用切比雪夫多项式表示。
concepts.formal: theorem Module.reflection_mul_reflection_mul_reflection_zpow_apply_self {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {x y : M} {f g : Dual R M} (hf : f x = 2) (hg : g y = 2) (m : ℤ) (t : R := f y * g x - 2) (ht : t = f y * g x - 2 := by rfl) :(reflection hg * (reflection hf * reflection hg) ^ m) x = (Polynomial.eval t (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R m) + Polynomial.eval t (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R (m - 1))) • x + (Polynomial.eval t (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R m) * -g x) • y

concepts.cn: 反射乘积自然数幂公式
concepts.definition: 两个反射乘积的自然数次幂作用的显式公式（切比雪夫多项式形式）。
concepts.formal: theorem Module.reflection_mul_reflection_pow_apply_self {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {x y : M} {f g : Dual R M} (hf : f x = 2) (hg : g y = 2) (m : ℕ) (t : R := f y * g x - 2) (ht : t = f y * g x - 2 := by rfl) :((reflection hf * reflection hg) ^ m) x = (Polynomial.eval t (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R ↑m) + Polynomial.eval t (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R (↑m - 1))) • x + (Polynomial.eval t (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R (↑m - 1)) * -g x) • y

concepts.cn: 反射乘积幂的算子公式
concepts.definition: 两个反射乘积的整数次幂作为线性算子的显式表达式。
concepts.formal: theorem Module.reflection_mul_reflection_zpow {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {x y : M} {f g : Dual R M} (hf : f x = 2) (hg : g y = 2) (m : ℤ) (t : R := f y * g x - 2) (ht : t = f y * g x - 2 := by rfl) :↑((reflection hf * reflection hg) ^ m) = LinearMap.id + (Polynomial.eval t (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R ((m - 2) / 2)) * (Polynomial.eval t (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R ((m - 1) / 2)) + Polynomial.eval t (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R ((m - 3) / 2)))) • (LinearMap.smulRight (g x • f - g) y - LinearMap.smulRight f x) + (Polynomial.eval t (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R ((m - 1) / 2)) * (Polynomial.eval t (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R (m / 2)) + Polynomial.eval t (Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R ((m - 2) / 2)))) • (LinearMap.smulRight (f y • g - f) x - LinearMap.smulRight g y)

concepts.definition: 根系基的正性可对加法做归纳：关于和的命题可化归为加项。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.Base.IsPos.induction_on_add {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {P : RootPairing ι R M N} {b : P.Base} [CharZero R] [Finite ι] [IsDomain R] [P.IsCrystallographic] {i : ι} (h₀ : b.IsPos i) {p : ι → Prop} (h₁ : ∀ i ∈ b.support, p i) (h₂ : ∀ (i j k : ι), P.root k = P.root i + P.root j → p i → j ∈ b.support → p k) :p i

concepts.definition: 基的整权基在第 i 个支撑元上的取值就是根系配对的第 i 个根。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.Base.coe_toWeightBasisInt_apply {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {P : RootPairing ι R M N} (b : P.Base) [CharZero R] (i : ↥b.support) :↑(b.toWeightBasisInt i) = P.root ↑i

concepts.definition: 根系基中，若 t 倍的基元仍在支撑集中，则 t = 1 或 t = −1。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.Base.eq_one_or_neg_one_of_mem_support_of_smul_mem {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {P : RootPairing ι R M N} (b : P.Base) [CharZero R] [Finite ι] [HasUniqueDiv M] [HasUniqueDiv N] (i : ι) (h : i ∈ b.support) (t : R) (ht : t • P.root i ∈ Set.range ⇑P.root) :t = 1 ∨ t = -1

concepts.definition: 每个根都可表为基根的整数线性组合，且系数全非负或全非正。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.Base.exists_root_eq_sum_int {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {P : RootPairing ι R M N} (b : P.Base) [CharZero R] (i : ι) :∃ (f : ι → ℤ), Function.support f ⊆ ↑b.support ∧ (0 < f ∨ f < 0) ∧ P.root i = ∑ j ∈ b.support, f j • P.root j

concepts.definition: 每个根等于基根的自然数线性组合，或其相反数。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.Base.exists_root_eq_sum_nat_or_neg {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {P : RootPairing ι R M N} (b : P.Base) (i : ι) :∃ (f : ι → ℕ), Function.support f ⊆ ↑b.support ∧ (P.root i = ∑ j ∈ b.support, f j • P.root j ∨ P.root i = -∑ j ∈ b.support, f j • P.root j)

concepts.definition: 高度函数满足 b.height k = b.height i + z • b.height j。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.Base.height_add_zsmul {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {P : RootPairing ι R M N} (b : P.Base) [CharZero R] {i j k : ι} {z : ℤ} (hk : P.root k = P.root i + z • P.root j) :b.height k = b.height i + z • b.height j

concepts.definition: 基元 i 为正，当且仅当其高度非负。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.Base.isPos_iff' {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {P : RootPairing ι R M N} (b : P.Base) [CharZero R] {i : ι} :b.IsPos i ↔ 0 ≤ b.height i

concepts.definition: 不同基元之间的整数配对值非正。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.Base.pairingIn_le_zero_of_ne {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {P : RootPairing ι R M N} (b : P.Base) [CharZero R] [IsDomain R] [P.IsCrystallographic] [Finite ι] {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (hi : i ∈ b.support) (hj : j ∈ b.support) :P.pairingIn ℤ i j ≤ 0

concepts.definition: 基支撑集上余根的张成等于余根张成空间。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.Base.span_coroot_support {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {P : RootPairing ι R M N} (b : P.Base) :Submodule.span R (⇑P.coroot '' ↑b.support) = P.corootSpan R

concepts.definition: 限制标量后余根的强制转换等于原来的余根。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.restrictScalars_coe_coroot {ι : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [Field L] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module L M] [Module L N] (P : RootPairing ι L M N) (K : Type u_5) [Field K] [Algebra K L] [Module K M] [Module K N] [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower K L N] [P.IsBalanced] [P.IsValuedIn K] (i : ι) :↑((P.restrictScalars' K).coroot i) = P.coroot i

concepts.definition: 根在不可分解基上的限制是线性无关的。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.linearIndepOn_root_baseOf' {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [Finite ι] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [CommRing R] [Module R M] [Module R N] (P : RootPairing ι R M N) [IsDomain R] {S : Type u_6} [LinearOrder S] [CommRing S] [IsStrictOrderedRing S] [Algebra S R] [FaithfulSMul S R] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower S R M] [Module S N] [IsScalarTower S R N] [P.IsValuedIn S] [P.IsCrystallographic] (f : Module.Dual S M) (hf : ∀ (i : ι), f (P.root i) ≠ 0) :LinearIndepOn S (⇑P.root) (IsAddIndecomposable.baseOf ⇑P.root ↑f)

concepts.definition: 两个根系配对相等，当且仅当其线性映射、根集、余根值域都对应相等。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.ext_iff {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Finite ι] [CharZero R] [IsDomain R] {P₁ P₂ : RootPairing ι R M N} :P₁ = P₂ ↔ P₁.toLinearMap = P₂.toLinearMap ∧ P₁.root = P₂.root ∧ Set.range ⇑P₁.coroot = Set.range ⇑P₂.coroot

concepts.definition: Cartan 矩阵的 (i,j) 元为零，当且仅当两根之和不是根。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.Base.cartanMatrix_apply_eq_zero_iff {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {P : RootPairing ι R M N} (b : P.Base) [P.IsCrystallographic] [CharZero R] [IsDomain R] [Finite ι] {i j : ↥b.support} (hij : i ≠ j) :b.cartanMatrix i j = 0 ↔ P.root ↑i + P.root ↑j ∉ Set.range ⇑P.root

concepts.definition: 存在正对角矩阵 d，使 Cartan 矩阵右乘 diag(d) 后正定。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.Base.exists_cartanMatrix_mul_diagaonal_posDef {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {P : RootPairing ι R M N} (b : P.Base) [P.IsCrystallographic] [CharZero R] [IsDomain R] [Finite ι] [DecidableEq ι] [P.IsRootSystem] :∃ (d : ↥b.support → ℤ), (∀ (i : ↥b.support), 0 < d i) ∧ (b.cartanMatrix * Matrix.diagonal d).PosDef

concepts.definition: 根链的顶系数与底系数之差等于配对值的相反数。

concepts.definition: 关于根的反射把根集双射地映到自身。

concepts.definition: 根系配对中必存在非零根。

concepts.definition: 翻转配对的反射置换等于原配对的反射置换。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.flip_reflectionPerm {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (P : RootPairing ι R M N) (a✝ : ι) :P.flip.reflectionPerm a✝ = P.reflectionPerm a✝

concepts.definition: 关于根的反射把根集映到自身。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.mapsTo_reflection_root {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (P : RootPairing ι R M N) (i : ι) :Set.MapsTo (⇑(P.reflection i)) (Set.range ⇑P.root) (Set.range ⇑P.root)

concepts.cn: 配对与反射置换的交换
concepts.definition: 配对与反射置换可交换次序。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.pairing_reflectionPerm {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (P : RootPairing ι R M N) (i j k : ι) :P.pairing j ((P.reflectionPerm i) k) = P.pairing ((P.reflectionPerm i) j) k

concepts.cn: 配对为零的反射不动点

concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.reflectionPerm_eq_of_pairing_eq_zero' {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {P : RootPairing ι R M N} {i j : ι} (h : P.pairing i j = 0) :(P.reflectionPerm i) j = j

concepts.definition: 两反射置换相等当且仅当两反射相等（在标量正则条件下）。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.reflectionPerm_eq_reflectionPerm_iff_of_isSMulRegular {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (P : RootPairing ι R M N) (i j : ι) (h2 : IsSMulRegular M 2) :P.reflectionPerm i = P.reflectionPerm j ↔ P.reflection i = P.reflection j

concepts.definition: 余极化映射可表为根的线性组合：CoPolarization x = Σ (root' i x) • root i。
concepts.formal: theorem RootPairing.CoPolarization_apply {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (P : RootPairing ι R M N) [Fintype ι] (x : N) :P.CoPolarization x = ∑ i : ι, (P.root' i) x • P.root i

concepts.definition: 余根形式的作用公式：(CorootForm x) y = Σ (root' i x)(root' i y)。

concepts.definition: 整数配对值非正关于指标对称。

concepts.formal: theorem TensorProduct.directLimitLeft_symm_of_tmul {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] {ι : Type u_2} [DecidableEq ι] [Preorder ι] {G : ι → Type u_3} [(i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (G i)] [(i : ι) → Module R (G i)] (f : (i j : ι) → i ≤ j → G i →ₗ[R] G j) (M : Type u_4) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {i : ι} (g : G i) (m : M) :(directLimitLeft f M).symm ((Module.DirectLimit.of R ι (fun (x : ι) => TensorProduct R (G x) M) (fun (i j : ι) (h : i ≤ j) => LinearMap.rTensor M (f i j h)) i) (g ⊗ₜ[R] m)) = (Module.DirectLimit.of R ι G f i) g ⊗ₜ[R] m

concepts.formal: theorem TensorProduct.gradedComm_gradedMul {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [CommSemiring ι] [Module ι (Additive ℤˣ)] [DecidableEq ι] (𝒜 : ι → Type u_3) (ℬ : ι → Type u_4) [CommRing R] [(i : ι) → AddCommGroup (𝒜 i)] [(i : ι) → AddCommGroup (ℬ i)] [(i : ι) → Module R (𝒜 i)] [(i : ι) → Module R (ℬ i)] [DirectSum.GRing 𝒜] [DirectSum.GRing ℬ] [DirectSum.GAlgebra R 𝒜] [DirectSum.GAlgebra R ℬ] (x y : TensorProduct R (DirectSum ι 𝒜) (DirectSum ι ℬ)) :(gradedComm R 𝒜 ℬ) (((gradedMul R 𝒜 ℬ) x) y) = ((gradedMul R ℬ 𝒜) ((gradedComm R 𝒜 ℬ) x)) ((gradedComm R 𝒜 ℬ) y)

concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.lTensor_comp_map {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (M : Type u_4) {N : Type u_5} {P : Type u_6} {Q : Type u_7} {S : Type u_8} [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N] [AddCommMonoid P] [AddCommMonoid Q] [AddCommMonoid S] [Module R M] [Module R N] [Module R S] [Module R P] [Module R Q] (g' : Q →ₗ[R] S) (f : M →ₗ[R] P) (g : N →ₗ[R] Q) :lTensor P g' ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map f g = TensorProduct.map f (g' ∘ₗ g)

concepts.definition: 左张量作用在张量映射像上的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.lTensor_map {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (M : Type u_4) {N : Type u_5} {P : Type u_6} {Q : Type u_7} {S : Type u_8} [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N] [AddCommMonoid P] [AddCommMonoid Q] [AddCommMonoid S] [Module R M] [Module R N] [Module R S] [Module R P] [Module R Q] (g' : Q →ₗ[R] S) (f : M →ₗ[R] P) (g : N →ₗ[R] Q) (x : TensorProduct R M N) :(lTensor P g') ((TensorProduct.map f g) x) = (TensorProduct.map f (g' ∘ₗ g)) x

concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.rTensor_comp_map {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (M : Type u_4) {N : Type u_5} {P : Type u_6} {Q : Type u_7} {S : Type u_8} [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N] [AddCommMonoid P] [AddCommMonoid Q] [AddCommMonoid S] [Module R M] [Module R N] [Module R S] [Module R P] [Module R Q] (f' : P →ₗ[R] S) (f : M →ₗ[R] P) (g : N →ₗ[R] Q) :rTensor Q f' ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map f g = TensorProduct.map (f' ∘ₗ f) g

concepts.formal: theorem Algebra.TensorProduct.opAlgEquiv_apply (R : Type u_1) (S : Type u_2) (A : Type u_3) (B : Type u_4) [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R S] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra S A] [IsScalarTower R S A] (x : TensorProduct R Aᵐᵒᵖ Bᵐᵒᵖ) :(opAlgEquiv R S A B) x = MulOpposite.op ((_root_.TensorProduct.map ↑(MulOpposite.opLinearEquiv R).symm ↑(MulOpposite.opLinearEquiv R).symm) x)

concepts.cn: 右 π 映射的计算
concepts.definition: 右 π 映射的计算公式。
concepts.formal: theorem TensorProduct.piRight_apply (R : Type u_1) [CommSemiring R] (S : Type u_2) [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S] (N : Type u_3) [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Module S N] [IsScalarTower R S N] {ι : Type u_4} (M : ι → Type u_5) [(i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (M i)] [(i : ι) → Module R (M i)] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (x : TensorProduct R N ((i : ι) → M i)) :(piRight R S N M) x = (piRightHom R S N M) x

concepts.definition: 左乘积映射在纯张量上的分配公式。
concepts.formal: theorem TensorProduct.prodLeft_tmul (R : Type u_1) (S : Type u_2) (M₁ : Type u_3) (M₂ : Type u_4) (M₃ : Type u_5) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [AddCommMonoid M₃] [Algebra R S] [Module R M₁] [Module S M₁] [IsScalarTower R S M₁] [Module R M₂] [Module R M₃] [Module S M₂] [IsScalarTower R S M₂] (m₁ : M₁) (m₂ : M₂) (m₃ : M₃) :(prodLeft R S M₁ M₂ M₃) ((m₁, m₂) ⊗ₜ[R] m₃) = (m₁ ⊗ₜ[R] m₃, m₂ ⊗ₜ[R] m₃)

concepts.definition: 商张量等价的逆与商投影复合的公式。
concepts.formal: theorem TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul_symm_comp_mkQ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (I : Ideal R) :↑(quotTensorEquivQuotSMul M I).symm ∘ₗ (I • ⊤).mkQ = (mk R (R ⧸ I) M) 1

concepts.definition: 张量商等价在 x ⊗ [r] 上的取值为商元 r•x。
concepts.formal: theorem TensorProduct.tensorQuotEquivQuotSMul_tmul_mk {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (I : Ideal R) (x : M) (r : R) :(tensorQuotEquivQuotSMul M I) (x ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) r) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (r • x)

concepts.definition: 典范映射 (mk R (R⧸I) Q) 1 的核等于 I•⊤。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.ker_tensorProductMk {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (Q : Type u_5) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] {I : Ideal R} :((TensorProduct.mk R (R ⧸ I) Q) 1).ker = I • ⊤

concepts.definition: 右逆的逆映射在左张量像上的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem lTensor.inverse_of_rightInverse_apply {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} {P : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [AddCommGroup P] [Module R M] [Module R N] [Module R P] {f : M →ₗ[R] N} {g : N →ₗ[R] P} (Q : Type u_5) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] (hfg : Function.Exact ⇑f ⇑g) {h : P → N} (hgh : Function.RightInverse h ⇑g) (y : TensorProduct R Q N) :(inverse_of_rightInverse Q hfg hgh) ((LinearMap.lTensor Q g) y) = Submodule.Quotient.mk y

concepts.definition: 代数张量包含值域等价的底层代数同态公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Algebra.TensorProduct.algEquivIncludeRange_toAlgHom (R : Type u_1) (S : Type u_2) (T : Type u_3) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S] [Semiring T] [Algebra R T] :↑(algEquivIncludeRange R S T) = map includeLeft.rangeRestrict includeRight.rangeRestrict

concepts.definition: 包含值域等价在纯张量上的公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Algebra.TensorProduct.linearEquivIncludeRange_tmul (R : Type u_1) (S : Type u_2) (T : Type u_3) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S] [Semiring T] [Algebra R T] (x : S) (y : T) :(linearEquivIncludeRange R S T) (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) = includeLeft.rangeRestrict x ⊗ₜ[R] includeRight.rangeRestrict y

concepts.definition: 乘法映射在纯张量上化为乘法：(A.mulMap B)(a⊗b) = a*b。
concepts.formal: theorem Subalgebra.mulMap_tmul {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S] (A B : Subalgebra R S) (a : ↥A) (b : ↥B) :(A.mulMap B) (a ⊗ₜ[R] b) = ↑a * ↑b

concepts.definition: 左乘映射等于乘法映射与右张量等的复合。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.mulLeftMap_eq_mulMap_comp {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S] {M : Submodule R S} (N : Submodule R S) {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] (m : ι → ↥M) :mulLeftMap N m = M.mulMap N ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor (↥N) (Finsupp.linearCombination R m) ∘ₗ ↑(TensorProduct.finsuppScalarLeft R (↥N) ι).symm

concepts.definition: 乘法映射在右单位子代数上的化简。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.mulMap_one_right_eq {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S] (M : Submodule R S) :M.mulMap (Subalgebra.toSubmodule ⊥) = M.subtype ∘ₗ ↑M.rTensorOne

concepts.definition: 反代数上乘法映射的交换公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.mulMap_op {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S] (M N : Submodule R S) :(equivOpposite.symm (MulOpposite.op M)).mulMap (equivOpposite.symm (MulOpposite.op N)) = ↑(MulOpposite.opLinearEquiv R) ∘ₗ N.mulMap M ∘ₗ ↑(TensorProduct.congr ((MulOpposite.opLinearEquiv R).symm.ofSubmodule' M) ((MulOpposite.opLinearEquiv R).symm.ofSubmodule' N) ≪≫ₗ TensorProduct.comm R ↥M ↥N)

concepts.definition: 右单位张量映射在纯张量上的计算得 y•m。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.rTensorOne'_tmul {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S] {M : Submodule R S} (y : R) (m : ↥M) :M.rTensorOne' (m ⊗ₜ[R] (algebraMap R ↥⊥) y) = y • m

concepts.definition: 基变换同态的作用就是基变换。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.baseChangeHom_apply (R : Type u_1) (A : Type u_2) (M : Type u_4) (N : Type u_5) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R M] [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :(baseChangeHom R A M N) f = baseChange A f

concepts.definition: 基变换保持取负。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.baseChange_neg {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :baseChange A (-f) = -baseChange A f

concepts.definition: 基变换保持幂。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.baseChange_pow (R : Type u_1) (A : Type u_2) (M : Type u_4) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (f : Module.End R M) (n : ℕ) :baseChange A (f ^ n) = baseChange A f ^ n

concepts.definition: 基变换把零子模送到零子模。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.baseChange_bot {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (A : Type u_3) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] :baseChange A ⊥ = ⊥

concepts.definition: 基变换把全空间送到全空间。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.baseChange_top {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (A : Type u_3) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] :baseChange A ⊤ = ⊤

concepts.definition: 到基变换的典范映射是满射。
concepts.formal: theorem Submodule.toBaseChange_surjective {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (A : Type u_3) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (p : Submodule R M) :Function.Surjective ⇑(toBaseChange A p)

concepts.definition: 基变换与消基变换复合的恒等式。
concepts.formal: theorem TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.baseChange_comp_cancelBaseChange_symm_self {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] (f : TensorProduct R A M →ₗ[A] N) :LinearMap.baseChange A f ∘ₗ ↑(cancelBaseChange R A A A M).symm = ↑(TensorProduct.lid A N).symm ∘ₗ f

concepts.definition: 代数张量模中右张量的强制转换公式。
concepts.formal: theorem TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.coe_rTensor {R : Type uR} {A : Type uA} {M : Type uM} {N : Type uN} {P : Type uP} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module A M] [IsScalarTower R A M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] [Module A P] [IsScalarTower R A P] (f : M →ₗ[A] P) :⇑((rTensor R N) f) = ⇑(LinearMap.rTensor N (↑R f))

concepts.definition: 左张量保持乘法。
concepts.formal: theorem TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor_mul {R : Type uR} {A : Type uA} {M : Type uM} {N : Type uN} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module A M] [IsScalarTower R A M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] (f₁ f₂ : N →ₗ[R] N) :(lTensor A M) (f₁ * f₂) = (lTensor A M) f₁ * (lTensor A M) f₂

concepts.cn: 双线性张量映射的公式
concepts.definition: 双线性映射的张量作用公式。
concepts.formal: theorem TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.mapBilinear_apply {R : Type uR} {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {M : Type uM} {N : Type uN} {P : Type uP} {Q : Type uQ} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module A M] [IsScalarTower R A M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] [Module A P] [IsScalarTower R A P] [AddCommMonoid Q] [Module R Q] [Module B P] [IsScalarTower R B P] [SMulCommClass A B P] (f : M →ₗ[A] P) (g : N →ₗ[R] Q) :((mapBilinear R A B M N P Q) f) g = map f g

concepts.definition: 典范映射 mk 的显式定义。
concepts.formal: theorem TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.mk_apply (R : Type uR) [CommSemiring R] (A : Type u_1) (M : Type u_2) (N : Type u_3) [Semiring A] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module A M] [SMulCommClass R A M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] (m : M) :(mk R A M N) m = { toFun := fun (x2 : N) => m ⊗ₜ[R] x2, map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ }

concepts.cn: 张量消失的单射性刻画
concepts.definition: 张量消失平凡性与右张量单射性的等价刻画。
concepts.formal: theorem TensorProduct.forall_vanishesTrivially_iff_forall_fg_rTensor_injective (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {N : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] :(∀ {l : ℕ} {m : Fin l → M} {n : Fin l → N}, ∑ i : Fin l, m i ⊗ₜ[R] n i = 0 → VanishesTrivially R m n) ↔ ∀ (M' : Submodule R M), M'.FG → Function.Injective ⇑(LinearMap.rTensor N M'.subtype)

concepts.definition: 迹为零的幂等元必为零。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.eq_zero_of_trace_eq_zero {R : Type u_6} [CommRing R] [CharZero R] {M : Type u_7} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {e : M →ₗ[R] M} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) [Module.Free R ↥e.range] [Module.Finite R ↥e.range] [Module.Free R ↥e.ker] [Module.Finite R ↥e.ker] :(trace R M) e = 0 → e = 0

concepts.definition: 幂等元迹为零，当且仅当其为零。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.trace_eq_zero_iff {R : Type u_6} [CommRing R] [CharZero R] {M : Type u_7} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {e : M →ₗ[R] M} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) [Module.Free R ↥e.range] [Module.Finite R ↥e.range] [Module.Free R ↥e.ker] [Module.Finite R ↥e.ker] :(trace R M) e = 0 ↔ e = 0

concepts.definition: 投影的迹等于其像空间的维数。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.IsProj.trace {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {p : Submodule R M} {f : M →ₗ[R] M} (h : IsProj p f) [Module.Free R ↥p] [Module.Finite R ↥p] [Module.Free R ↥f.ker] [Module.Finite R ↥f.ker] :(LinearMap.trace R M) f = ↑(Module.finrank R ↥p)

concepts.definition: 幂零映射的迹幂零。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.isNilpotent_trace_of_isNilpotent {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {f : M →ₗ[R] M} (hf : IsNilpotent f) :IsNilpotent ((trace R M) f)

concepts.definition: 辅助迹用矩阵迹计算。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.traceAux_def (R : Type u) [CommSemiring R] {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {ι : Type w} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :(traceAux R b) f = ((toMatrix b b) f).trace

concepts.definition: 辅助迹与基的选择无关。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.traceAux_eq (R : Type u) [CommSemiring R] {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {ι : Type w} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {κ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype κ] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : Module.Basis κ R M) :traceAux R b = traceAux R c

concepts.definition: 迹与基变换相容。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_baseChange {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] (f : M →ₗ[R] M) (A : Type u_6) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] :(trace A (TensorProduct R A M)) (baseChange A f) = (algebraMap R A) ((trace R M) f)

concepts.definition: 迹的复合交换律（范畴形式）。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_comp_comm (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_2) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (N : Type u_3) [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Free R N] [Module.Finite R N] :(llcomp R M N M).compr₂ (trace R M) = (llcomp R N M N).flip.compr₂ (trace R N)

concepts.definition: tr(g∘f) = tr(f∘g)，迹的循环性。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_comp_comm' {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {N : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Free R N] [Module.Finite R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] M) :(trace R M) (g ∘ₗ f) = (trace R N) (f ∘ₗ g)

concepts.definition: tr(gfh) = tr(fhg)。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_comp_cycle {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {N : Type u_3} {P : Type u_4} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] [Module.Free R N] [Module.Finite R N] [Module.Free R P] [Module.Finite R P] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] P) (h : P →ₗ[R] M) :(trace R P) (g ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ h) = (trace R N) (f ∘ₗ h ∘ₗ g)

concepts.definition: 另一种三元复合迹循环形式。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_comp_cycle' {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {N : Type u_3} {P : Type u_4} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Free R P] [Module.Finite R P] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] P) (h : P →ₗ[R] M) :(trace R P) ((g ∘ₗ f) ∘ₗ h) = (trace R M) ((h ∘ₗ g) ∘ₗ f)

concepts.definition: 交换且幂零情形下迹的乘法公式。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_comp_eq_mul_of_commute_of_isNilpotent {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [IsReduced R] {f g : Module.End R M} (μ : R) (h_comm : Commute f g) (hg : IsNilpotent (g - (algebraMap R (Module.End R M)) μ)) :(trace R M) (f ∘ₗ g) = μ * (trace R M) f

concepts.definition: 迹在共轭下不变：tr(fgf⁻¹) = tr(g)。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_conj (R : Type u) [CommSemiring R] {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (g : M →ₗ[R] M) (f : (M →ₗ[R] M)ˣ) :(trace R M) (↑f * g * ↑f⁻¹) = (trace R M) g

concepts.definition: 等价共轭下的迹不变。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_conj' {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {N : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] M) (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :(trace R N) (e.conj f) = (trace R M) f

concepts.definition: 迹等于对偶张量同态与左缩并的复合。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_eq_contract (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_2) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] :trace R M ∘ₗ dualTensorHom R M M = contractLeft R M

concepts.definition: 迹的缩并表示（等价形式）。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_eq_contract' (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_2) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] :trace R M = contractLeft R M ∘ₗ ↑(dualTensorHomEquiv R M M).symm

concepts.definition: 迹在对偶张量元上的缩并计算。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_eq_contract_apply (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_2) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] (x : TensorProduct R (Module.Dual R M) M) :(trace R M) ((dualTensorHom R M M) x) = (contractLeft R M) x

concepts.definition: 基意义下迹等于缩并复合。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_eq_contract_of_basis {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {ι : Type u_5} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) :trace R M ∘ₗ dualTensorHom R M M = contractLeft R M

concepts.definition: 迹的缩并表示（基形式）。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_eq_contract_of_basis' {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {ι : Type u_5} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) :trace R M = contractLeft R M ∘ₗ ↑(dualTensorHomEquivOfBasis b).symm

concepts.definition: 线性映射的迹等于其矩阵的迹。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace (R : Type u) [CommSemiring R] {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {ι : Type w} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :(trace R M) f = ((toMatrix b b) f).trace

concepts.definition: 有限集指标下迹等于矩阵迹。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace_of_finset (R : Type u) [CommSemiring R] {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {s : Finset M} (b : Module.Basis (↥s) R M) (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :(trace R M) f = ((toMatrix b b) f).trace

concepts.definition: 恒等映射的迹等于空间维数。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_id (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_2) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] :(trace R M) id = ↑(Module.finrank R M)

concepts.definition: 李括号的迹为零：tr[f,g] = 0。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_lie {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (f g : Module.End R M) :(trace R M) ⁅f, g⁆ = 0

concepts.definition: tr([f,g]h) = tr(f[g,h])。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_lie_mul_eq {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (f g h : M →ₗ[R] M) :(trace R M) (⁅f, g⁆ * h) = (trace R M) (f * ⁅g, h⁆)

concepts.definition: 迹与映射相容。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_map {K : Type u_6} {V : Type u_7} {W : Type u_8} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] {F : Type u_9} [EquivLike F (Module.End K V) (Module.End K W)] [AlgEquivClass F K (Module.End K V) (Module.End K W)] (f : F) (x : Module.End K V) :(trace K W) (f x) = (trace K V) x

concepts.definition: tr(fg) = tr(gf)，迹的乘法交换律。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_mul_comm (R : Type u) [CommSemiring R] {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (f g : M →ₗ[R] M) :(trace R M) (f * g) = (trace R M) (g * f)

concepts.definition: tr(fgh) = tr(hfg)。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_mul_cycle (R : Type u) [CommSemiring R] {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (f g h : M →ₗ[R] M) :(trace R M) (f * g * h) = (trace R M) (h * f * g)

concepts.definition: tr(f(gh)) = tr(h(fg))。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_mul_cycle' (R : Type u) [CommSemiring R] {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (f g h : M →ₗ[R] M) :(trace R M) (f * (g * h)) = (trace R M) (h * (f * g))

concepts.definition: 单位元的迹等于维数。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_one (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_2) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] :(trace R M) 1 = ↑(Module.finrank R M)

concepts.definition: 乘积映射的迹的分解公式。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_prodMap (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_2) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (N : Type u_3) [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Free R N] [Module.Finite R N] :trace R (M × N) ∘ₗ prodMapLinear R M N M N R = id.coprod id ∘ₗ (trace R M).prodMap (trace R N)

concepts.definition: 乘积映射的迹等于各分量迹之和。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_prodMap' {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {N : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Free R N] [Module.Finite R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] M) (g : N →ₗ[R] N) :(trace R (M × N)) (f.prodMap g) = (trace R M) f + (trace R N) g

concepts.definition: 迹在右数乘下的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_smulRight {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] (f : M →ₗ[R] R) (x : M) :(trace R M) (f.smulRight x) = f x

concepts.definition: 张量积的迹的双线性公式。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_tensorProduct (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_2) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (N : Type u_3) [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Free R N] [Module.Finite R N] :(TensorProduct.mapBilinear (RingHom.id R) M N M N).compr₂ (trace R (TensorProduct R M N)) = (lsmul R R).compl₁₂ (trace R M) (trace R N)

concepts.definition: 张量映射的迹等于迹的乘积。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_tensorProduct' {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {N : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Free R N] [Module.Finite R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] M) (g : N →ₗ[R] N) :(trace R (TensorProduct R M N)) (TensorProduct.map f g) = (trace R M) f * (trace R N) g

concepts.definition: 对偶转置的迹等于原迹。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_transpose (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_2) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] :trace R (Module.Dual R M) ∘ₗ Module.Dual.transpose = trace R M

concepts.definition: 转置映射的迹不变。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearMap.trace_transpose' {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :(trace R (Module.Dual R M)) (Module.Dual.transpose f) = (trace R M) f

concepts.definition: 矩阵映射保持迹。
concepts.formal: theorem Matrix.trace_map {K : Type u_6} {m : Type u_7} {n : Type u_8} [Field K] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] {F : Type u_9} [EquivLike F (Matrix m m K) (Matrix n n K)] [AlgEquivClass F K (Matrix m m K) (Matrix n n K)] (f : F) (x : Matrix m m K) :(f x).trace = x.trace

concepts.definition: 矩阵映射保持迹（另一形式）。
concepts.formal: theorem Matrix.trace_map' {K : Type u_6} {m : Type u_7} {F : Type u_8} [Field K] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [FunLike F (Matrix m m K) (Matrix m m K)] [AlgHomClass F K (Matrix m m K) (Matrix m m K)] (f : F) (x : Matrix m m K) :(f x).trace = x.trace

concepts.definition: 矩阵对应线性映射的迹等于矩阵迹。
concepts.formal: theorem Matrix.trace_toLin'_eq {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] {ι : Type w} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (A : Matrix ι ι R) :(LinearMap.trace R (ι → R)) (toLin' A) = A.trace

concepts.definition: 基下矩阵对应映射的迹等于矩阵迹。
concepts.formal: theorem Matrix.trace_toLin_eq {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {ι : Type w} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (A : Matrix ι ι R) (b : Module.Basis ι R M) :(LinearMap.trace R M) ((toLin b b) A) = A.trace

concepts.definition: 错切变换包含于膨胀错切变换中。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearEquiv.transvections_subset_dilatransvections {R : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup V] [Module R V] :transvections R V ⊆ dilatransvections R V

concepts.cn: 特殊线性群的错切分解
concepts.definition: 特殊线性群元素的错切分解。
concepts.formal: theorem LinearEquiv.mem_transvections_pow_mul_dilatransvections_of_fixedReduce_eq_one {K : Type u_1} [DivisionRing K] {V : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Module.Finite K V] {e : V ≃ₗ[K] V} (he : e.fixedReduce = 1) :e ∈ transvections K V ^ (Module.finrank K (V ⧸ (↑e).fixedSubmodule) - 1) * dilatransvections K V

concepts.definition: 幺模向量可扩充为基（二维情形）。
concepts.formal: theorem Module.IsUnimodular.exists_basis_zero_eq {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Free R M] (hM : finrank R M = 2) {v : M} (hv : IsUnimodular R v) :∃ (e : Basis (Fin 2) R M), e 0 = v

concepts.cn: 酉群的 star 封闭性
concepts.definition: 矩阵取 star 后属于酉群，当且仅当原矩阵属于酉群。
concepts.formal: theorem Matrix.map_star_mem_unitaryGroup_iff {n : Type u} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] {α : Type v} [CommRing α] [StarRing α] {U : Matrix n n α} :U.map star ∈ unitaryGroup n α ↔ U ∈ unitaryGroup n α

concepts.definition: 自然数在矩阵环中酉，当且仅当在系数环中酉。
concepts.formal: theorem Matrix.ofNat_mem_unitary {n : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] [Semiring R] [StarRing R] [Nonempty n] {k : ℕ} [k.AtLeastTwo] :OfNat.ofNat k ∈ unitary (Matrix n n R) ↔ OfNat.ofNat k ∈ unitary R

concepts.definition: 转置属于酉群，当且仅当原矩阵属于酉群。
concepts.formal: theorem Matrix.transpose_mem_unitaryGroup_iff {n : Type u} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] {α : Type v} [CommRing α] [StarRing α] {U : Matrix n n α} :U.transpose ∈ unitaryGroup n α ↔ U ∈ unitaryGroup n α

concepts.cn: 范德蒙行列式的平移不变性
concepts.definition: 平移后的范德蒙行列式不变。
concepts.formal: theorem Matrix.det_vandermonde_sub {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R) (a : R) :(vandermonde fun (i : Fin n) => v i - a).det = (vandermonde v).det

concepts.definition: 恒等等价的嵌入同余是恒等嵌入。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.embeddingCongr_refl {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_2} :(Equiv.refl α).embeddingCongr (Equiv.refl β) = Equiv.refl (α ↪ β)

concepts.definition: 嵌入同余的逆等于逆的嵌入同余。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.embeddingCongr_symm {α₁ : Sort u_1} {β₁ : Sort u_2} {α₂ : Sort u_3} {β₂ : Sort u_4} (e₁ : α₁ ≃ α₂) (e₂ : β₁ ≃ β₂) :(e₁.embeddingCongr e₂).symm = e₁.symm.embeddingCongr e₂.symm

concepts.definition: 满嵌入对应的等价的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.embeddingSurjectiveEquiv_apply {α : Sort u_1} {β : Type u_2} (f : { f : α ↪ β // Function.Surjective ⇑f }) :embeddingSurjectiveEquiv f = (↑f).equivOfSurjective ⋯

concepts.definition: 等价转嵌入在点上的取值就是原函数值。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.toEmbedding_apply {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (f : α ≃ β) (a : α) :f.toEmbedding a = f a

concepts.definition: 箭头左同余的计算公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.arrowCongrLeft_apply {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} {γ : Sort w} [Inhabited γ] (e : α ↪ β) (f : α → γ) :e.arrowCongrLeft f = extend (⇑e) f default

concepts.definition: 嵌入构造子的底层函数就是原函数。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_2} (f : α → β) (i : Injective f) :⇑{ toFun := f, inj' := i } = f

concepts.definition: 商代表元嵌入的底层函数是 Quotient.out。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.coe_quotientOut (α : Sort u_1) [Setoid α] :⇑(quotientOut α) = Quotient.out

concepts.definition: 恒等嵌入的底层函数是恒等函数。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.coe_refl (α : Sort u_1) :⇑(Embedding.refl α) = id

concepts.definition: 子类型嵌入的底层函数是 Subtype.val。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.coe_subtype {α : Sort u_1} (p : α → Prop) :⇑(subtype p) = Subtype.val

concepts.definition: 嵌入复合的底层函数是函数复合。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.coe_trans {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_2} {γ : Sort u_3} (f : α ↪ β) (g : β ↪ γ) :⇑(f.trans g) = ⇑g ∘ ⇑f

concepts.definition: 嵌入与其逆嵌入的复合是恒等嵌入。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.equiv_toEmbedding_trans_symm_toEmbedding {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_2} (e : α ≃ β) :e.toEmbedding.trans e.symm.toEmbedding = Embedding.refl α

concepts.definition: 两个嵌入构造子的复合对应函数的复合。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.mk_trans_mk {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_2} {γ : Sort u_3} (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (hf : Injective f) (hg : Injective g) :{ toFun := f, inj' := hf }.trans { toFun := g, inj' := hg } = { toFun := g ∘ f, inj' := ⋯ }

concepts.definition: 嵌入的 option 映射就是 Option.map。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.optionMap_apply {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (f : α ↪ β) :⇑f.optionMap = Option.map ⇑f

concepts.definition: 恒等嵌入作用得自身。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.refl_apply (α : Sort u_1) (a : α) :(Embedding.refl α) a = a

concepts.definition: 恒等嵌入复合任意嵌入得该嵌入。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.refl_trans {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (f : α ↪ β) :(Embedding.refl α).trans f = f

concepts.definition: 左截面嵌入的计算公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.sectL_apply (α : Type u_1) {β : Type u_2} (b : β) (a : α) :(sectL α b) a = (a, b)

concepts.definition: 设值嵌入在该点取给定值。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.setValue_eq {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_2} (f : α ↪ β) (a : α) (b : β) [(a' : α) → Decidable (a' = a)] [(a' : α) → Decidable (f a' = b)] :(f.setValue a b) a = b

concepts.definition: 箭头左同余与嵌入复合可交换。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.trans_arrowCongrLeft {α₁ : Sort u} {α₂ : Sort v} {α₃ : Sort x} {γ : Sort w} [Inhabited γ] (e₁₂ : α₁ ↪ α₂) (e₂₃ : α₂ ↪ α₃) :e₁₂.arrowCongrLeft.trans e₂₃.arrowCongrLeft = (e₁₂.trans e₂₃).arrowCongrLeft

concepts.definition: 存在满射，当且仅当两类都非空且有反向嵌入。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.exists_surjective_iff {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_2} :(∃ (f : α → β), Surjective f) ↔ Nonempty (α → β) ∧ Nonempty (β ↪ α)

concepts.definition: 蕴含嵌入的底层取值公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Subtype.impEmbedding_apply_coe {α : Type u_1} (p q : α → Prop) (h : ∀ (x : α), p x → q x) (x : { x : α // p x }) :↑((impEmbedding p q h) x) = ↑x

concepts.definition: 子类型或左嵌入的左分支公式。
concepts.formal: theorem subtypeOrLeftEmbedding_apply_left {α : Type u_1} {p q : α → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (x : { x : α // p x ∨ q x }) (hx : p ↑x) :(subtypeOrLeftEmbedding p q) x = Sum.inl ⟨↑x, hx⟩

concepts.definition: 嵌入的 option 消去的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.optionElim_apply {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (f : α ↪ β) (x : β) (h : ¬x ∈ Set.range ⇑f) (a✝ : Option α) :(f.optionElim x h) a✝ = Option.elim' x (⇑f) a✝

concepts.definition: option 嵌入等价的逆的公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.optionEmbeddingEquiv_symm_apply (α : Type u_1) (β : Type u_2) (f : (f : α ↪ β) × ↑(Set.range ⇑f)ᶜ) :(optionEmbeddingEquiv α β).symm f = f.fst.optionElim ↑f.snd ⋯

concepts.definition: sigma 集嵌入的值域是各集合之并。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Embedding.sigmaSet_range {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {s : ι → Set α} (h : Pairwise (onFun Disjoint s)) :Set.range ⇑(sigmaSet h) = ⋃ (i : ι), s i

concepts.definition: 子集嵌入的底层取值公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Set.embeddingOfSubset_apply_coe {α : Type u_1} (s t : Set α) (h : s ⊆ t) (x : ↑s) :↑((s.embeddingOfSubset t h) x) = ↑x

concepts.definition: 有向序列单调。
concepts.formal: theorem Directed.sequence_mono {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Encodable α] [Inhabited α] [Preorder β] {f : α → β} (hf : Directed (fun (x1 x2 : β) => x1 ≤ x2) f) :Monotone (f ∘ Directed.sequence f hf)

concepts.definition: 选择函数满足谓词。
concepts.formal: theorem Encodable.choose_spec {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [Encodable α] [DecidablePred p] (h : ∃ (x : α), p x) :p (choose h)

concepts.definition: 二元解码是单射。
concepts.formal: theorem Encodable.decode₂_inj {α : Type u_1} [Encodable α] {n : ℕ} {a₁ a₂ : α} (h₁ : a₁ ∈ decode₂ α n) (h₂ : a₂ ∈ decode₂ α n) :a₁ = a₂

concepts.definition: 假的编码为 0。
concepts.formal: theorem Encodable.encode_false :encode false = 0

concepts.definition: 单位元的编码为 0。
concepts.formal: theorem Encodable.encode_star :encode PUnit.unit = 0

concepts.definition: 下确界提升由 up 唯一决定。
concepts.formal: theorem ULower.ext {α : Type u_1} [Encodable α] {a b : ULower α} :a.up = b.up → a = b

concepts.definition: down 后再 up 回到自身。
concepts.formal: theorem ULower.up_down {α : Type u_1} [Encodable α] {a : α} :(down a).up = a

concepts.definition: 解码划分的两两不交性。
concepts.formal: theorem Encodable.iUnion_decode₂_disjoint_on {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Encodable β] {f : β → Set α} (hd : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint f)) :Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint fun (i : ℕ) => ⋃ b ∈ decode₂ β i, f b)

concepts.definition: 置换扩张定义域的计算公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.Perm.extendDomain_apply_subtype {α' : Type u_8} {β' : Type u_9} (e : Perm α') {p : β' → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (f : α' ≃ Subtype p) {b : β'} (h : p b) :(e.extendDomain f) b = ↑(f (e (f.symm ⟨b, h⟩)))

concepts.definition: 扩张定义域与等价复合可交换。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.Perm.extendDomain_trans {α' : Type u_8} {β' : Type u_9} {p : β' → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (f : α' ≃ Subtype p) (e e' : Perm α') :Equiv.trans (e.extendDomain f) (e'.extendDomain f) = extendDomain (Equiv.trans e e') f

concepts.definition: 子类型同余左分支的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.Perm.subtypeCongr.left_apply {ε : Type u_8} {p : ε → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (ep : Perm { a : ε // p a }) (en : Perm { a : ε // ¬p a }) {a : ε} (h : p a) :(ep.subtypeCongr en) a = ↑(ep ⟨a, h⟩)

concepts.definition: 子类型同余在子类型元上的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.Perm.subtypeCongr.left_apply_subtype {ε : Type u_8} {p : ε → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (ep : Perm { a : ε // p a }) (en : Perm { a : ε // ¬p a }) (a : { a : ε // p a }) :(ep.subtypeCongr en) ↑a = ↑(ep a)

concepts.definition: 恒等等价的子类型同余是恒等。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.Perm.subtypeCongr.refl {ε : Type u_8} {p : ε → Prop} [DecidablePred p] :subtypeCongr (Equiv.refl { a : ε // p a }) (Equiv.refl { a : ε // ¬p a }) = Equiv.refl ε

concepts.definition: 子类型同余与等价复合可交换。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.Perm.subtypeCongr.trans {ε : Type u_8} {p : ε → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (ep ep' : Perm { a : ε // p a }) (en en' : Perm { a : ε // ¬p a }) :Equiv.trans (ep.subtypeCongr en) (ep'.subtypeCongr en') = subtypeCongr (Equiv.trans ep ep') (Equiv.trans en en')

concepts.definition: 和同余中交换子的作用公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.Perm.sumCongr_refl_swap {α : Type u_8} {β : Type u_9} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (i j : β) :sumCongr (Equiv.refl α) (swap i j) = swap (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inr j)

concepts.definition: 交换子与和同余的作用公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.Perm.sumCongr_swap_refl {α : Type u_8} {β : Type u_9} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (i j : α) :(swap i j).sumCongr (Equiv.refl β) = swap (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j)

concepts.definition: 交换不改变函数在交换点外的值。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.apply_swap_eq_self {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_4} [DecidableEq α] {v : α → β} {i j : α} (hv : v i = v j) (k : α) :v ((swap i j) k) = v k

concepts.definition: 子类型余定义域等价的逆的显式公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.coe_subtypeEquivCodomain_symm {X : Sort u_8} {Y : Sort u_9} [DecidableEq X] {x : X} (f : { x' : X // x' ≠ x } → Y) :⇑(subtypeEquivCodomain f).symm = fun (y : Y) => ⟨fun (x' : X) => if h : x' ≠ x then f ⟨x', h⟩ else y, ⋯⟩

concepts.definition: 交换映射下集合的像的公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.image_swap_of_mem_of_notMem {α : Type u_8} [DecidableEq α] {s : Set α} {i j : α} (hi : i ∈ s) (hj : ¬j ∈ s) :Set.image (⇑(swap i j)) s = insert j s \ {i}

concepts.definition: 等价蕴含空类型的刻画。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.isEmpty {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_4} (e : α ≃ β) [IsEmpty β] :IsEmpty α

concepts.cn: 左 π 同余的计算
concepts.definition: 左 π 同余的计算公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply_eq_cast {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_4} {P : β → Sort v} {e : α ≃ β} (f : (a : α) → P (e a)) (b : β) :(piCongrLeft P e) f b = cast ⋯ (f (e.symm b))

concepts.cn: 集合 π 同余的计算
concepts.definition: 集合 π 同余的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.piCongrSet_apply {α : Type u_10} {W : α → Sort w} {s t : Set α} (h : s = t) (f : (i : { i : α // i ∈ s }) → W ↑i) (i : { i : α // i ∈ t }) :(piCongrSet h) f i = f ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩

concepts.cn: 纤维 π 同余的逆
concepts.definition: 纤维 π 同余逆的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.piCongrSigmaFiber_symm_apply {α : Type u_8} {β : Type u_9} {f : α → β} {γ₁ : α → Sort u_10} {γ₂ : α → Sort u_11} (e : (a : α) → γ₁ a ≃ γ₂ a) (g : (a : α) → γ₂ a) (σ : (y : β) × { x : α // f x = y }) :(piCongrSigmaFiber e).symm g σ = (e ↑σ.snd).symm (g ↑σ.snd)

concepts.definition: π 同余的逐点计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.piCongr_apply_apply {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_4} {W : α → Sort w} {Z : β → Sort z} (h₁ : α ≃ β) (h₂ : (a : α) → W a ≃ Z (h₁ a)) (f : (a : α) → W a) (a : α) :(h₁.piCongr h₂) f (h₁ a) = (h₂ a) (f a)

concepts.cn: π 同余逆的逐点计算
concepts.definition: π 同余逆的逐点计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.piCongr_symm_apply {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_4} {W : α → Sort w} {Z : β → Sort z} (h₁ : α ≃ β) (h₂ : (a : α) → W a ≃ Z (h₁ a)) (f : (b : β) → Z b) :(h₁.piCongr h₂).symm f = fun (a : α) => (h₂ a).symm (f (h₁ a))

concepts.definition: π 咖喱化的计算公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.piCurry_apply {α : Type u_10} {β : α → Type u_8} (γ : (a : α) → β a → Type u_9) (f : (x : (i : α) × β i) → γ x.fst x.snd) :(piCurry γ) f = Sigma.curry f

concepts.definition: option π 等价的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.piOptionEquivProd_apply {α : Type u_9} {β : Option α → Type u_8} (f : (a : Option α) → β a) :piOptionEquivProd f = (f none, fun (a : α) => f (some a))

concepts.definition: option π 等价逆的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.piOptionEquivProd_symm_apply {α : Type u_9} {β : Option α → Type u_8} (x : β none × ((a : α) → β (some a))) (a : Option α) :piOptionEquivProd.symm x a = Option.casesOn a x.fst x.snd

concepts.definition: 共轭给出半共轭关系。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.semiconj_conj {α₁ : Type u_10} {β₁ : Type u_11} (e : α₁ ≃ β₁) (f : α₁ → α₁) :Function.Semiconj (⇑e) f (e.conj f)

concepts.definition: sigma 结合逆的第一分量公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.sigmaAssocProd_symm_apply_fst {α : Type u_8} {β : Type u_9} {γ : α → β → Type u_10} (a✝ : (a : α) × (b : β) × γ a b) :(sigmaAssocProd.symm a✝).fst = (((sigmaAssoc γ).symm a✝).fst.fst, ((sigmaAssoc γ).symm a✝).fst.snd)

concepts.definition: sigma 子类型等价的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.sigmaSigmaSubtypeEq_apply {α : Type u_8} {β : Type u_9} {γ : α → β → Type u_10} {a : α} {b : β} (s : { s : (a : α) × (b : β) × γ a b // s.fst = a ∧ s.snd.fst = b }) :(sigmaSigmaSubtypeEq a b) s = cast ⋯ (↑s).snd.snd

concepts.definition: sigma 子类型等价逆的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.sigmaSigmaSubtype_symm_apply {α : Type u_8} {β : α → Type u_9} {γ : (a : α) → β a → Type u_10} (p : (a : α) × β a → Prop) [uniq : Unique { ab : (a : α) × β a // p ab }] {a : α} {b : β a} (c : γ a b) (h : p ⟨a, b⟩) :(sigmaSigmaSubtype p h).symm c = ⟨⟨a, ⟨b, c⟩⟩, h⟩

concepts.definition: sigma 子类型映射的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.sigmaSubtype_apply {α : Type u_8} {β : α → Type u_9} (a : α) (x✝ : { s : Sigma β // s.fst = a }) :(sigmaSubtype a) x✝ = match x✝ with | ⟨⟨fst, b⟩, h⟩ => h ▸ b

concepts.cn: 余定义域等价逆的逐点公式
concepts.definition: 余定义域等价逆的逐点公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.subtypeEquivCodomain_symm_apply {X : Sort u_8} {Y : Sort u_9} [DecidableEq X] {x : X} (f : { x' : X // x' ≠ x } → Y) (y : Y) (x' : X) :↑((subtypeEquivCodomain f).symm y) x' = if h : x' ≠ x then f ⟨x', h⟩ else y

concepts.cn: 右子类型等价的逆映射
concepts.definition: 右子类型等价的逆仍保持子类型成员关系，给出逆向等价的显式公式。
concepts.en: Inverse of a Right Subtype Equivalence
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.subtypeEquivRight_symm_apply {α : Sort u_1} {p q : α → Prop} (e : ∀ (x : α), p x ↔ q x) (z : { x : α // q x }) :(subtypeEquivRight e).symm z = ⟨↑z, ⋯⟩

concepts.cn: 右子类型等价逆的底层
concepts.definition: 右子类型等价逆的底层公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.subtypeEquivRight_symm_apply_coe {α : Sort u_1} {p q : α → Prop} (e : ∀ (x : α), p x ↔ q x) (b : { b : α // q b }) :↑((subtypeEquivRight e).symm b) = ↑b

concepts.definition: 恒等的子类型等价是恒等。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.subtypeEquiv_refl {α : Sort u_1} {p : α → Prop} (h : ∀ (a : α), p a ↔ p ((Equiv.refl α) a) := ⋯) :(Equiv.refl α).subtypeEquiv h = Equiv.refl { a : α // p a }

concepts.definition: 子类型原像等价逆的逐点公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.subtypePreimage_symm_apply_coe {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_4} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (x₀ : { a : α // p a } → β) (x : { a : α // ¬p a } → β) (a : α) :↑((subtypePreimage p x₀).symm x) a = if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else x ⟨a, h⟩

concepts.definition: 正分支上的子类型原像公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.subtypePreimage_symm_apply_coe_pos {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_4} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (x₀ : { a : α // p a } → β) (x : { a : α // ¬p a } → β) (a : α) (h : p a) :↑((subtypePreimage p x₀).symm x) a = x₀ ⟨a, h⟩

concepts.definition: 商子类型等价逆在商元上的公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.subtypeQuotientEquivQuotientSubtype_symm_mk {α : Sort u_1} (p₁ : α → Prop) [s₁ : Setoid α] [s₂ : Setoid (Subtype p₁)] (p₂ : Quotient s₁ → Prop) (hp₂ : ∀ (a : α), p₁ a ↔ p₂ ⟦a⟧) (h : ∀ (x y : Subtype p₁), s₂ x y ↔ ↑x ≈ ↑y) (x : Subtype p₁) :(subtypeQuotientEquivQuotientSubtype p₁ p₂ hp₂ h).symm ⟦x⟧ = ⟨⟦↑x⟧, ⋯⟩

concepts.definition: 双重子类型等价的底层公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.subtypeSubtypeEquivSubtypeExists_apply_coe {α : Sort u_1} (p : α → Prop) (q : Subtype p → Prop) (a : Subtype q) :↑((subtypeSubtypeEquivSubtypeExists p q) a) = ↑↑a

concepts.definition: 全集子类型等价逆的公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.subtypeUnivEquiv_symm_apply {α : Sort u_8} {p : α → Prop} (h : ∀ (x : α), p x) (x : α) :(subtypeUnivEquiv h).symm x = ⟨x, ⋯⟩

concepts.definition: 交换映射取值的等价刻画。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.swap_apply_eq_iff {α : Sort u_1} [DecidableEq α] {x y z w : α} :(swap x y) z = w ↔ z = (swap x y) w

concepts.definition: 交换映射在异于交换点处为恒等。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne {α : Sort u_1} [DecidableEq α] {a b x : α} :x ≠ a → x ≠ b → (swap a b) x = x

concepts.definition: 左固定交换给出单射。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.swap_injective_of_left {α : Sort u_1} [DecidableEq α] (a : α) :Function.Injective fun (x : α) => swap a x

concepts.definition: 交换映射的逆是自身。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.symm_swap {α : Sort u_1} [DecidableEq α] (a b : α) :Equiv.symm (swap a b) = swap a b

concepts.definition: 单射与交换映射可交换：f(swap x y z) = swap (f x)(f y)(f z)。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Injective.map_swap {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_4} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] {f : α → β} (hf : Injective f) (x y z : α) :f ((Equiv.swap x y) z) = (Equiv.swap (f x) (f y)) (f z)

concepts.definition: 单射下交换的像公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Injective.swap_apply {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_4} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] {f : α → β} (hf : Injective f) (x y z : α) :(Equiv.swap (f x) (f y)) (f z) = f ((Equiv.swap x y) z)

concepts.definition: 对合转置换的底层函数是原函数。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Involutive.coe_toPerm {α : Sort u_1} {f : α → α} (h : Involutive f) :⇑(toPerm f h) = f

concepts.definition: 对合等价的逆是自身。
concepts.formal: theorem Function.Involutive.symm_eq_self_of_involutive {α : Sort u_1} (f : Equiv.Perm α) (h : Involutive ⇑f) :Equiv.symm f = f

concepts.definition: 布尔非有右逆。
concepts.formal: theorem Bool.not_hasRightInverse :Function.HasRightInverse not

concepts.definition: 布尔非是单射。
concepts.formal: theorem Bool.not_injective :Function.Injective not

concepts.definition: 布尔非等价的逆作用为取非。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.boolNot_symm_apply (x : Bool) :(Equiv.symm boolNot) x = !x

concepts.cn: 恒等的 sigma 右同余
concepts.definition: 恒等的 sigma 右同余是恒等。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.Perm.sigmaCongrRight_refl {α : Type u_1} {β : α → Type u_2} :(sigmaCongrRight fun (a : α) => Equiv.refl (β a)) = Equiv.refl ((a : α) × β a)

concepts.definition: sigma 右同余的逆公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.Perm.sigmaCongrRight_symm {α : Type u_1} {β : α → Type u_2} (F : (a : α) → Perm (β a)) :Equiv.symm (sigmaCongrRight F) = sigmaCongrRight fun (a : α) => Equiv.symm (F a)

concepts.definition: sigma 右同余与复合可交换。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.Perm.sigmaCongrRight_trans {α : Type u_1} {β : α → Type u_2} (F G : (a : α) → Perm (β a)) :Equiv.trans (sigmaCongrRight F) (sigmaCongrRight G) = sigmaCongrRight fun (a : α) => Equiv.trans (F a) (G a)

concepts.definition: f x = f y ↔ x = y。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (f : α ≃ β) {x y : α} :f x = f y ↔ x = y

concepts.definition: 箭头同余与函数复合的相容性。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.arrowCongr_comp {α₁ : Sort u_1} {β₁ : Sort u_2} {γ₁ : Sort u_3} {α₂ : Sort u_4} {β₂ : Sort u_5} {γ₂ : Sort u_6} (ea : α₁ ≃ α₂) (eb : β₁ ≃ β₂) (ec : γ₁ ≃ γ₂) (f : α₁ → β₁) (g : β₁ → γ₁) :(ea.arrowCongr ec) (g ∘ f) = (eb.arrowCongr ec) g ∘ (ea.arrowCongr eb) f

concepts.definition: 等价给出双射。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.bijective {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (e : α ≃ β) :Function.Bijective ⇑e

concepts.definition: 双射等价的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.bijectiveEquiv_apply {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (f : { f : α → β // Function.Bijective f }) :bijectiveEquiv f = ofBijective ↑f ⋯

concepts.definition: 双射等价逆的底层公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.bijectiveEquiv_symm_apply_coe {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (f : α ≃ β) (a : α) :↑(bijectiveEquiv.symm f) a = f a

concepts.definition: 强制转换的恒等是自反。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.cast_refl {α : Sort u_1} (h : α = α := ⋯) :Equiv.cast h = Equiv.refl α

concepts.definition: 等价由底层函数唯一决定。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.coe_inj {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} {e₁ e₂ : α ≃ β} :⇑e₁ = ⇑e₂ ↔ e₁ = e₂

concepts.definition: 由双射构造的等价的底层函数是原函数。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.coe_ofBijective {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Bijective f) :⇑(ofBijective f hf) = f

concepts.definition: 等价复合的底层函数是函数复合。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.coe_trans {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} {γ : Sort w} (f : α ≃ β) (g : β ≃ γ) :⇑(f.trans g) = ⇑g ∘ ⇑f

concepts.definition: 等价复合保持双射性。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.comp_bijective {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} {γ : Sort w} (f : α → β) (e : β ≃ γ) :Function.Bijective (⇑e ∘ f) ↔ Function.Bijective f

concepts.definition: 等价复合保持单射性。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.comp_injective {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} {γ : Sort w} (f : α → β) (e : β ≃ γ) :Function.Injective (⇑e ∘ f) ↔ Function.Injective f

concepts.definition: 方程 f = g ∘ e⁻¹ 的变形。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.eq_comp_symm {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_2} {γ : Sort u_3} (e : α ≃ β) (f : β → γ) (g : α → γ) :f = g ∘ ⇑e.symm ↔ f ∘ ⇑e = g

concepts.definition: f = g⁻¹ 当且仅当 f∘g 为恒等。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.eq_symm_iff_trans_eq_refl {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} {f : α ≃ β} {g : β ≃ α} :f = g.symm ↔ f.trans g = Equiv.refl α

concepts.definition: 等价同余的逐点计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.equivCongr_apply_apply {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} {γ : Sort w} {δ : Sort u_1} (ab : α ≃ β) (cd : γ ≃ δ) (e : α ≃ γ) (x : β) :((ab.equivCongr cd) e) x = cd (e (ab.symm x))

concepts.definition: 单位类型等价逆的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.equivPUnit_symm_apply (α : Sort u) [Unique α] (a✝ : PUnit) :(equivPUnit α).symm a✝ = default

concepts.definition: 唯一存在量词在等价下保持。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.existsUnique_congr_left {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} {p : α → Prop} (e : α ≃ β) :(∃! a : α, p a) ↔ ∃! b : β, p (e.symm b)

concepts.definition: 存在量词在等价下保持。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.exists_congr_right {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} {q : β → Prop} (e : α ≃ β) :(∃ (a : α), q (e a)) ↔ ∃ (b : β), q b

concepts.definition: 等价由逐点作用唯一决定。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.ext {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} {f g : α ≃ β} (H : ∀ (x : α), f x = g x) :f = g

concepts.definition: 三元全称量词在等价下保持。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.forall₃_congr {α₁ : Sort u_1} {α₂ : Sort u_2} {β₁ : Sort u_3} {β₂ : Sort u_4} {γ₁ : Sort u_5} {γ₂ : Sort u_6} {p : α₁ → β₁ → γ₁ → Prop} {q : α₂ → β₂ → γ₂ → Prop} (eα : α₁ ≃ α₂) (eβ : β₁ ≃ β₂) (eγ : γ₁ ≃ γ₂) (h : ∀ {x : α₁} {y : β₁} {z : γ₁}, p x y z ↔ q (eα x) (eβ y) (eγ z)) :(∀ (x : α₁) (y : β₁) (z : γ₁), p x y z) ↔ ∀ (x : α₂) (y : β₂) (z : γ₂), q x y z

concepts.definition: 函数交换等价的底层是 Function.swap。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.functionSwap_apply (α : Sort u_1) (β : Sort u_2) (γ : α → β → Sort u_3) :⇑(functionSwap α β γ) = Function.swap

concepts.definition: 逆是左逆。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.left_inv' {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (e : α ≃ β) :Function.LeftInverse ⇑e.symm ⇑e

concepts.definition: 等价保持 max 运算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.max_def {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (e : α ≃ β) [Max β] (a b : α) :max a b = e.symm (max (e a) (e b))

concepts.definition: 等价保持非空性。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.nonempty_congr {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (e : α ≃ β) :Nonempty α ↔ Nonempty β

concepts.definition: 等价保持非平凡性。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.nontrivial_congr {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (e : α ≃ β) :Nontrivial α ↔ Nontrivial β

concepts.definition: 由双射构造的等价逐点作用。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.ofBijective_apply {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Bijective f) (a✝ : α) :(ofBijective f hf) a✝ = f a✝

concepts.definition: 唯一类型间等价的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.ofUnique_apply (α : Sort u) (β : Sort v) [Unique α] [Unique β] (a✝ : α) :(ofUnique α β) a✝ = default a✝

concepts.definition: 置换同余的定义展开。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.permCongr_def {α' : Type u_1} {β' : Type u_2} (e : α' ≃ β') (p : Perm α') :e.permCongr p = (e.symm.trans p).trans e

concepts.definition: 置换同余的逆公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.permCongr_symm {α' : Type u_1} {β' : Type u_2} (e : α' ≃ β') :e.permCongr.symm = e.symm.permCongr

concepts.definition: 置换同余与复合可交换。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.permCongr_trans {α' : Type u_1} {β' : Type u_2} (e : α' ≃ β') (p p' : Perm α') :Equiv.trans (e.permCongr p) (e.permCongr p') = e.permCongr (Equiv.trans p p')

concepts.definition: psigma 右同余的逆公式。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.psigmaCongrRight_symm {α : Sort u_3} {β₁ : α → Sort u_1} {β₂ : α → Sort u_2} (F : (a : α) → β₁ a ≃ β₂ a) :(psigmaCongrRight F).symm = psigmaCongrRight fun (a : α) => (F a).symm

concepts.cn: psigma 到 sigma 的等价
concepts.definition: psigma 到 sigma 的等价的计算。
concepts.formal: theorem Equiv.psigmaEquivSigma_apply {α : Type u_2} (β : α → Type u_1) (a : (i : α) ×' β i) :(psigmaEquivSigma β) a = ⟨a.fst, a.snd⟩

concepts.definition: 恒等等价作用得自身。
